definitions.text: Depth to anterior cortex / chord length: the distance along the transverse pedicle axis from the most posterior point on the transverse process to the anterior cortex of the vertebra (Figure 3).

definitions.section: Figure 3 for the chord definition; place of the population statements not recorded (full text)
definitions.text: Twenty-four AIS patients, curves <100°, 14 female and 10 male; mean age 14.6 years (12.3–18.3), mean Cobb 76° (58–98°); King II 12, King III 7, King IV 5. [own inference] Convex is read as right and concave as left because all 24 patients had right thoracic/thoracolumbar curves; the paper does not explicitly equate convex with right.

Tables 1–3 explicitly label means, ranges, SD and number of pedicles separately. The printed field preserves the literal mean column; decimals records its printed decimal places. Table 4 conflicts are kept separately and are not used; Tables 1–3 supply primary figures. Doubtful cells remain usable as printed, while the impossible L4 convex angle is retained only for inspection.

The Table 3 title, results subheading and abstract describe “The length of the pedicle from the posterior cortex to the anterior cortex of the vertebra (mm)”. Figure 1 instead says “The pedicle length from the posterior cortex of the pedicle to the posterior longitudinal ligament along the axis of the pedicle”. Both descriptions are retained; the endpoint contradiction is unresolved. The paper does not define the ± statistic; interpreting it as SD is this project’s own inference. Per-age-band and sex child counts are not stated.
